name: ZCA_BI_USER_LOGIN_ACTIVITY
description: contains Consolidated  Session count and session length per day for each user.

columns.name: USER_LOGIN_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: The latest user Guid of the user.

columns.name: USER_LOGIN_DATE
columns.description: Calendar Date of the Login

columns.name: CHANNEL_CODE
columns.description: Channel the user logged in through

columns.name: IMPERSONATOR_GUID
columns.description: Impersonator GUID with which user logged in

columns.name: IMPERSONATOR_NAME
columns.description: Impersonator Name of the logged in user

columns.name: USER_LOGIN_COUNT
columns.description: Count of number of  User Login  user  on the reported date

columns.name: USER_LOGIN_DURATION
columns.description: Duration user stayed logged into the system

columns.description: Foreign Key to table ZPS_CLIENT_USAGES for Office 365

columns.name: DEVICE_MODE
columns.description: Device type from which user used Office365 client application. User could connect using Thick Client, Office Online or Mobile

columns.name: PLATFORM_CODE
columns.description: The OEC Integration Platform for which the data usage collected. Possible values are: Office 365, Gmail, IBM, Classic Outlook

columns.name: DEVICE_TERRITORY_CODE

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
